name: std::counting_semaphore<LeastMaxValue>::max
intro: Returns the internal counter's maximum possible value, which is greater than or equal to LeastMaxValue.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The internal counter's maximum possible value, as a std::ptrdiff_t.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
For specialization binary_semaphore, LeastMaxValue is equal to 1.

As its name indicates, the LeastMaxValue is the minimum max value, not the actual max value. Thus max() can yield a number larger than LeastMaxValue.
